summary.zh: 东亚花园与公园最常见的凤蝶，视觉系统以复杂著称。
summary.en: The most common swallowtail in East Asian gardens and parks, famous for its sophisticated colour vision.

field_marks.zh: 翅黄色有黑色脉纹与斑带，后翅有蓝斑与橙红眼斑，尾突短。
field_marks.en: Yellow wings with black veins and bands; blue and orange spots on the hindwing, short tails.

similar.zh: 与金凤蝶（P. machaon）相似，但本种前翅基部有黑色细纹。
similar.en: P. machaon is similar but lacks the fine black striping at the forewing base.

story.zh: 凤蝶科是蝴蝶中较早分化的一支。该种的复眼含至少六类光谱感受器，是研究蝴蝶色觉的模式种之一。
story.en: Swallowtails are an early-diverging butterfly lineage. Its compound eye has at least six spectral receptor classes, making it a model for butterfly colour vision.

notes.zh: 幼虫以柑橘类为食，所以果园与庭院多见。春至秋季多代发生。
notes.en: Larvae feed on citrus, so orchards and gardens are good places. Multiple generations from spring to autumn.
